verdict.rationale: Glama is a directory/hosting/gateway for MCP servers with search and per-tool access control, but there is no evidence of runtime meta-tool search/load capability (e.g., a 'search_tools'/'load_tool' meta-tool that lets an agent dynamically discover and inject tool definitions instead of preloading them into context). The catalog search (glama-docs-6) is a human/dev-facing directory feature, not an agent-callable meta-tool for dynamic tool loading.
